name: ai-brain
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated holographic sticker for Nuwanga Wijamuni's AI Engineer portfolio. Style: crisp playful editorial illustration, mostly flat 2D, smooth clean chunky black ink contours, pearlescent holographic foil INSIDE the shape with flowing pastel rainbow reflections in cyan, lavender, pink, pale yellow and mint. Similar to black-outline holographic stickers used against a minimal light-grey typographic technical website. Keep the sticker bold and legible at 180px. One centered subject, square composition, generous transparent margins on every side, no cropped edges. Authentic fully transparent alpha background, including holes and gaps. No white sticker border, no rectangular backing, no checkerboard pattern painted into the image, no ground plane, no drop shadow, no text, no logos, no watermark, no photorealism, no lens flares, no dramatic 3D bevels. The outline and internal ink marks must be consistently thick pure black. Foil reflection is glossy but not a glitter texture. Subject: an original stylized AI brain sticker viewed three-quarter from the side, gently tilted about 12 degrees upward. A single recognizable lobed brain silhouette with a small number of rounded winding fold lines, one subtle circuit connection detail worked into the folds, simple graphic shape, not realistic anatomy or exposed organ. Iridescent bands ripple across the whole brain. No robot face or extra objects.
